objective: Connect the existing standalone BUKLOD Health Center to Main's public Home and Profile Health Center entry points; do not modify Classroom.
productionBaselineEvidence: GitHub main cae4cbc427d877264f35390d74e15d28540e6e02 is the inspected source. Vercel project buklod-health-center has a READY production deployment dpl_C7Lp7U1uxiXskq4ibyHthEyEdZXs and verified buklod-health-center.vercel.app domain. Live browser behavior and exact Main installed production OTA are unverified. No publication authorized by this change.
chosenApproach: Reuse the already mounted Home Health Center card as a one-tap HTTPS browser launcher; replace the Profile's role-gated placeholder with a fallback launcher. Pass no auth token or medical data. Keep Classroom unchanged. Exempt only the patient doorway from the global privileged workspace route guard, preventing forced redirection for normal BUKLOD members.
selectionRationale: The patient-facing standalone site is already deployed; linking it uses less code and avoids exposing sensitive data or duplicating health modules in Main.
alternativeApproaches: Embed the entire Health Center into Main (rejected: violates standalone focus-app boundary and duplicates privacy-sensitive state).
Pass Supabase access and refresh tokens in URL for SSO (rejected: credentials leak through browser/history/logs).
Keep organization-role-gated placeholder for personal Health Center (rejected: ordinary members cannot open the patient app).
preserveBehaviors: All Classroom launch, student/faculty permissions and enrollment flows unchanged
No new medical permissions, backend migrations, token handoff, data copy or standalone Health Center deployment
Main Expo runtime, package, ads and bottom navigation unchanged
Existing Health Worker and all other privileged Focus App role gates remain enforced
acceptanceChecks: Home Health card one tap opens the exact standalone HTTPS URL
Profile Health route no longer shows integration-ready placeholder and offers retry/address if opening fails
No tokens or health data are attached to URL
No production OTA or web deployment until verified RC and release approval
Ordinary members reach the Health Center fallback page without a Health Worker role, while other Focus Apps remain gated
